statementCode.description: The CCSS standard code that was evaluated (matches the statementCode input)

description.description: The learning component description from the Knowledge Graph

reasoning.description: Concise explanation of what the LC requires, what the question asks, and why they do or do not align

aligned.description: True if the question directly elicits the skill described by this learning component

feedback.description: If aligned=false: concrete revision to make the item align. If aligned=true: brief confirmation.

alignedCount.description: Number of learning components this question aligns to

totalCount.description: Total number of learning components for this standard

coarseFiltered.description: True when this standard was excluded by the coarse filter in question bank mode — no LC-level evaluation was performed
